name: union-local-grievance-mgmt
description: Union Local Grievance Management System with Angular, Firebase Functions, and Firestore

scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "emulators,client" -c "yellow,blue" "npm run emulators" "npm --prefix client run start"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix functions run lint
scripts.test: CI=true PAGER=cat NX_DAEMON=false npm --prefix client run test -- --watch=false
